grain: district × building type × contract period × explicit deposit/area strata (not legal dong or administrative dong)
unit: money columns labelled 만원 are 10,000 KRW; monthly rent per month; deposit is refundable principal, not expense; area is reported rental area m², exclusive-area equivalence unverified
filters: monthly rent >0, deposit >=0, reported rental area 20–60 m² inclusive; apartment excluded; three building types kept separate
N: public rows, not verified unique contracts; identical public attributes can refer to distinct units
limitations: Receipt-year files filtered by contract date; late registrations/corrections/cancellations remain

No vendor revenue minus rent profit metric
Compare matched H1 only; do not annualize mismatched windows
matchedH1Area40to50: exact deposit 10,000,000 KRW; 연립다세대 only; rental area >40 and <=50 m²; N>=30 in both H1 periods
